items.title: Send these readings to your care team today
items.text: Your average blood sugar was 172.0 mg/dL, and 5.7% of your readings were above 250 mg/dL. Contact your care team today to discuss your readings.

items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: Walking after dinner went with a rise about 18.3 mg/dL smaller in the same person. Walking 10 to 19 minutes got most of the gain, with 17.5 mg/dL less.

items.title: Move dinner earlier
items.text: Sugar rose about 9.2 mg/dL more after late dinners than after earlier ones in the same person. Try to start dinner before 8 pm, as 50.0% of your dinners started at 8 pm or later.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: Your overnight fast averaged 11.9 hours, and 0.0% of nights reached 13 hours. Adding the overnight fast to coaching changed HbA1c by -0.03 points compared with coaching alone.
